blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte was a no-show at the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Thursday and instead sent her legal counsel to comply with the invitation letter sent to her amid the investigation into the cash delivery claims of dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. Duterte was first expected to appear last Monday, but her camp wrote to the NBI to request the resetting of the date of the investigative conference toThursday. The vice president’s lawyer, Atty. Clifford Chua arrived at the NBI headquarters in Pasay City around 10:15 a.m. When asked by reporters upon his arrival, […]...
